text.p: Israel's Nexus Telecommunications Systems Ltd said on Wednesday it had completed a two-part private placement totalling $4.5 million.

Nexus, which develops and manufactures low-energy wireless communications and location systems, said it raised $2.25 million after Israel's BVR Technologies Ltd exercised 642,857 series C warrants at a price of $3.50 a share.
The transaction raises BVR's stake in Nexus to 36 percent.
In consideration for exercising the warrants, BVR received an additional 321,428 series E five-year warrants with an exercise price of $5.35 a share, Nexus said.

The second portion of the placement raised $2.25 million through the issue of 1.5 million warrants at $1.50 each. Nexus said the exercise price on the warrants is $5.35, with the warrant price being credited towards this amount if the warrants are exercised.
